definitions.name: L1D.BSIGNS
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'C' BIND 1 -1 '([' C SEARCH NIL? NOT SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String -> Vector of +1 per opening bracket and -1 per closing bracket

definitions.name: L1D.BREDUCE
definitions.note: bracket String (up to 12 chars) with every adjacent matched pair () or [] repeatedly deleted

definitions.name: L1D.NAMES
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] pairs -> Vector of the names (first column)

definitions.name: L1D.AMOUNTS
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] pairs -> Vector of the amounts (second column)

definitions.name: L1D.ARGMAX
definitions.note: index of the largest number in a Vector, the first one when tied

definitions.name: L1D.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'TR' BIND TR KEYS TR VALUES L1D.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: Record with numeric values -> the key with the largest value, the earliest key when tied

definitions.name: L1D.BY-NAME
definitions.body: 'LE' BIND LE L1D.NAMES LE L1D.AMOUNTS GROUP 'LG' BIND LG KEYS LG VALUES [ G0A.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] pairs -> Record name -> sum of its amounts, names in first-appearance order

definitions.name: L1D.UNWORDS
definitions.note: Vector of words -> one String joined by single spaces

definitions.name: L1D.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: one word -> first letter upper case, the rest lower case

definitions.name: L1D.WHERE
definitions.body: 'WT' BIND 0 WT LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE [ 'WI' BIND WT WI GET ] FILTER
definitions.note: non-empty Vector of truths -> Vector of the indices holding TRUE

definitions.name: L1D.STARTS
definitions.body: 'SV' BIND [ TRUE ] SV 1 DROP SV -1 DROP SUB 'SD' BIND SD SD MUL 0 GT CONCAT L1D.WHERE
definitions.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> indices where a run of equal adjacent values starts

definitions.name: L1D.RLE
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND RV L1D.STARTS 'RS' BIND RV RS GET RS RV LENGTH 1 COLLECT CONCAT 'RE' BIND RE 1 DROP RE -1 DROP SUB 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> run-length encoding as Vector of [ value count ]

definitions.name: L1D.LONGEST-TRUE
definitions.body: 0 [ 'LU' BIND 'LA' BIND LA 1 ADD 0 LU SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: Vector of truths -> length of the longest run of adjacent TRUE (0 for none)

definitions.name: L1D.COUNT-TRUE
definitions.note: Vector of truths -> how many are TRUE

definitions.name: L1D.PRESENT
definitions.note: Vector -> the same Vector without its NIL elements

definitions.name: L1D.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'SS' BIND SS LENGTH 'SN' BIND SS SN 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET SS SN 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector (mean of the two middle values when the count is even)

definitions.name: L1D.ABS
definitions.note: absolute value of a number, lifts over Vectors
